channel.title: Plant Center on Solarhub Help Center
channel.description: Recent content in Plant Center on Solarhub Help Center

item.title: PVS
item.description: Overview of plant link The overview of the PVS plant includes four sections: real-time power, daily power, social benefits, and online plant. Real-time power: Summary display of the power and installed capacity of photovoltaic plants under the current login user data permission in the PVS Daily power: Display the daily power, monthly power generation, annual power generation, and cumulative power generation of photovoltaic plants under the current login user data permission Social benefits: The social benefits generated by the entire PVS under the current login user data permission, including tree species index, carbon dioxide emission reduction, and light bulb usage Online plants: The number of online plants and the total number of plants under the current login user data permission Plant list link The plant list displays some information of all online, faulty, and offline plants.

item.title: BESS
item.description: Overview of Plant link The overview of the plant of the BESS includes four sections: real-time power, charge and discharge statistics, social benefits, and online plant. Real-time power: Summary display of BESS power and installed capacity under the data permission of the current logged-in user in the BESS Charge and discharge statistics: Display the daily charge, daily discharge, cumulative charge, and cumulative discharge of the photovoltaic plant under the data permission of the current logged-in user Social benefits: The social benefits generated by the entire photovoltaic system under the data permission of the current logged-in user, including tree species index, carbon dioxide emission reduction, and light bulb usage Online plant: The number of online plants and the total number of plants under the data permission of the current logged-in user Plant list linkThis is the same as the photovoltaic system, please refer to Plant list

item.title: HESS
item.description: Overview of Plant link The overview of the plant for HESS includes four sections: power generation, power grid, battery, and power consumption. Power generation: Display the power generation power, photovoltaic installed capacity, daily power generation, monthly power generation, annual power generation, and annual power generation of HESS plants under the data permission of the current logged-in user Grid: Display the purchase and sale power of HESS plants under the data permission of the current logged-in user Battery: Display the SOC, daily discharge, and daily charging of HESS plants under the data permission of the current logged-in user Power consumption: Display the power consumption power, daily power consumption, monthly power consumption, annual power consumption, and total power consumption of HESS plants under the data permission of the current logged-in user Plant list linkThis is the same as the photovoltaic system, please refer to Plant list
